name: Meeting Bot
description: Sits in meetings for you. You control it from another device with the same name and password.

name.label: Bot name
name.detail: The name this bot uses. Together with the password it derives the secret admin meeting.

password.label: Bot password
password.detail: Never sent to a server. The same pair opens the admin meeting from another device.

start.label: Start right away
start.detail: 1 starts the bot (or the remote) as soon as you approve this launch.
